decision: <what was decided - stated so it stands alone without the meeting>
rationale: <why: the deciding reasons and evidence - and any dissent>
options_considered: <every option weighed - at least two - marking the one chosen>
decided_by: <the named decider - or the forum and its chair>
status: <Final / Provisional / Deferred / Superseded by Dnnn / Reversed>
method: <decider decides after input / consent / consensus / majority vote>
revisit_by: <YYYY-MM-DD when a Provisional or Deferred decision comes back - blank if Final>
log_ref: <issue-log DEC id or change-log CR id once merged - blank until then - local if the project keeps no issue log>
